subject: math
topicName: Geometry - Lesson 8: CPCTC and Theorem Problems
description: Use congruent triangles and CPCTC to prove corresponding parts, then apply related right triangle, isosceles triangle, perpendicular bisector, and midline theorem results.
learningObjectives: Explain what CPCTC means and when it may be used
Use triangle congruence to prove corresponding sides or angles congruent
Solve measures using right triangle congruence, isosceles triangle, perpendicular bisector, and midline theorem relationships
Write short statement-reason arguments that move from triangle congruence to corresponding parts
Identify common errors such as using CPCTC before proving triangles congruent
Connect theorem diagrams to algebraic measure problems
prerequisites: Identify corresponding sides and angles in congruent triangles
Apply SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, and HL triangle congruence conditions
Recognize right triangles, isosceles triangles, perpendicular bisectors, and triangle midlines
Solve one-step and two-step linear equations
Read congruence markings and geometric notation accurately
